card.name: Words before load, exposure or dose terms
card.fires_on: Small words just before a noun like workload, cumulative radiation exposure or daily dose, such as the possessive 's after patient, or balance, added, maximum.

modes.label: Possessive after patient
modes.description: The 's after patient in radiation risk statements, right before cumulative radiation exposure.
modes.example: Radiation risk: Choline C 11 Injection contributes to a patient<<’s>> long-term cumulative radiation exposure.

modes.label: Workload wording in IT
modes.description: Verbs or modifiers right before workloads in server clustering text.
modes.example: to ensure high availability and to<< balance>> workloads—to achieve this goal.

modes.label: Dose multiple wording
modes.description: Modifiers before recommended daily dose in animal study comparisons.
modes.example: approximately 2,700 times the<< maximum>> recommended daily sc dose for adults
